name: status-select
title: Status select
description: Pick a status where the shape tells the state, not the colour: a marker and a word per option, grouped into open and closed, in a compact trigger.
docs: statuses is the list: value, label, kind (backlog, todo, progress, review, done or cancelled; leave it out when you pass a marker) and an optional group. Options with the same group are listed together under a quiet heading, in the order the groups first appear. The six markers are drawn on a 16 unit grid and differ in shape, not only in weight; marker replaces one with your own 16px drawing, so the same select can show a stage or a priority. The list is the house Select: arrow keys, Home and End, typeahead on the words, Escape returns focus. showShortcuts writes 1 to 9 beside the first nine options and lets the number keys pick them while the list is open. size sm with variant ghost is the compact trigger for a table cell or a detail panel. The trigger shows the marker and the word, and a screen reader hears the group after them ("In progress, Open"). Name the trigger with aria-label, or with a Label whose htmlFor is its id. name and required make it a form field.
